cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've sorted your suspension with the headteacher, love. Put the calendar down; I'll take you through it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many days should I mark off?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A little break. Don't mark an end date from a guess, sweetheart. Leave the calendar to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then tell me if I should cross out the school play.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No crossing anything out. Come here, love. One thing at a time; I know how to get us through this.

reason: Retain declining disclosure and affection; make each corrective intervention respond to the child's actual calendar proposal.
